from pathlib import Path
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    left_w = w // 2
    out = [row[:left_w] for row in grid]
    objects = {}
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, grid[0][0])}:
        pts = [(r, c-left_w-1) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        if not pts:
            continue
        r0, c0 = min(r for r,c in pts), min(c for r,c in pts)
        objects[color] = frozenset((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts)
    panel_h = (h-1)//((h-1)//4) if False else None
    # Panels are separated by full-color horizontal rows; inspect each bounded panel.
    separators = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == grid[0][0] for v in row[:left_w])]
    for top,bottom in zip(separators,separators[1:]):
        pts = [(r-top-1,c-1) for r in range(top+1,bottom) for c in range(1,left_w-1) if grid[r][c] == 0]
        sig = frozenset(pts)
        color = next((col for col,shape in objects.items() if shape == sig), None)
        if color is not None:
            for r in range(top+1,bottom):
                for c in range(1,left_w-1):
                    if grid[r][c] == 0:
                        out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
